headword: {聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ}

definitions.gloss: interview survey; hearing investigation; oral inquiry
definitions.explanation: A survey or investigation conducted by directly interviewing people. Used in government, academic research, journalism, and workplace contexts to gather firsthand information.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: An interview survey of the residents was conducted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→被害者：14106_higaisha⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}められた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The interviews with the victims were carried out carefully.

examples.japanese: {聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}した→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I compiled the results of the interview survey and wrote a report.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{聞|き}き{取|と}り→聞き取る：04583_kikitoru⟧ (listening; hearing) + ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧ (investigation; survey). A standard method of data collection where an interviewer asks questions face-to-face or by phone and records the responses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to conduct an interview survey
- {聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: results of the hearing
- {聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ}⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧: interview survey report
- ⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧{聞|き}き{取|と}り{調査|ちょうさ}: on-site interview survey

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦アンケート→アンケート：03829_ankeeto⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: questionnaire survey — written form, not oral
- ヒアリング: hearing (loanword) — increasingly used in business and government as a synonym
- ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: interview survey (formal) — similar meaning with more formal nuance
- ⟦{取材|しゅざい}→取材：05227_shuzai⟧: news gathering; coverage — specifically journalistic interviews
